title: NATO Business Opportunity: NATO Beacon Projects and Multi-Domain C2 Focus Area at CWIX 2026
agency_path: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF.BUREAU OF INDUSTRY AND SECURITY
detail_text: The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) intends to issue a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for support to NATO Beacon Projects and Multi-Domain C2 Focus Area at CWIX 2026. Interested vendors may access the solicitation for this procurement opportunity as of the anticipated solicitation release date via NCIA’s eProcurement tool, Neo: https://www.ncia.nato.int/business/procurement/neo-eprocurement The reference for the RFQ is RFQ-CO-186487-CWIX and all correspondence concerning the RFQ should include this reference. SUMMARY OF REQUIREMENT This requirement serves as the foundation for NATO to utilize the SitaWare Headquarters software Suite in the context of the NATO Beacon Project Next Generation Targeting (NGT), which has the goal of streamlining and modernizing targeting processes to ensure precision and interoperability across Allied forces. The requirement primarily involves attendance at planning conferences ahead of CWIX 2026 and the assistance to a dedicated Multi-Domain Operation (MDO) environment at Coalition Warrior Interoperability eXploration, eXperimentation, eXamination eXercise 2026 (CWIX 2026) at the Joint Force Training Centre in Bydgoszcz, Poland. BECOMING ELIGIBLE TO BID A Declaration of Eligibility (DOE) is NOT required for bidding on RFQ-CO-186487-CWIX. IMPORTANT DATES: Anticipated Solicitation Release (planned): 09 March 2026 Bid Closing (anticipated): 23 March 2026 Contract Award (estimated): 01 April 2026
